title: Camp Australia Pty Ltd and Junior Adventures Group Pty Ltd - proposed merger

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC requested further information from the parties. Former provisional date for announcement of findings (27 July 2017) delayed.
ACCC received information from the merger parties.
ACCC published a Statement of Issues outlining preliminary competition concerns.

Parties requested more time to provide further information. Former provisional date for announcement of findings (26 October 2017) is delayed. ACCC will announce a revised proposed decision date in due course.
Following notification by the merger parties that the proposed merger has been terminated, the ACCC has discontinued this review.
